jobs.title: Director of Engineering (Remote)
jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

Location:
This role is fully remote but will directly manage team members spanning East Africa Time to US Pacific Time. You must overlap with East Africa Time by at least 3 hours. As an example, 6PM East Africa Time is 11AM US Eastern time in the summer and 10AM in the winter. In practice, if you are in the Eastern US timezone, that means being regularly available for 8AM meetings and some 7AM ones. We know people have commitments like school drop-offs, so you’re encouraged to set a schedule that works for you—as long as there’s sufficient overlap with the team.
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

About This Role

We’re hiring a Director of Engineering to build a best-in-class engineering department in a moment of rapid growth; we’ve more than doubled our engineering team in the last year and are continuing to hire.

Your initial focus will be on our cash delivery platform: you'll own the technical systems that deliver the next $4B to people in extreme poverty, our goal for the next nine years, with scenarios on the table that would require us to scale much faster. We recently launched a platform rebuild as a greenfield project, and the work ahead is scaling it from initial launch to delivering billions. This role is deliberately sequenced: you'll start close to the ground — directly managing engineers, partnering with our platform product lead on roadmap and delivery, and getting deep in the operational details (on-call, incident response) — because we believe the leader who builds that context firsthand is the one who can design the right organization for the next level of scale.

You will own maintaining and scaling a strong engineering culture through rapid growth: shaping how we hire and structure teams, recruiting and retaining a high talent density team, and building strong operating processes and culture that encourage open debate in search of the best outcomes for recipients rather than attachment to being right or looking good; continuous learning, improvement, and adoption of new tools; deep product ownership in service of impact for recipients; and strong judgment about tradeoffs. You'll set a high technical quality bar, pressure-testing designs and tradeoffs while still giving a very senior team high autonomy.

You’ll shape our multi-year technical strategy: where the platform should be shared across product lines versus split or modular, when to build versus buy versus extend, how to sequence major architectural transitions, and how to balance investment with feature development. You optimize for recipient impact, not the most interesting technical problem. We're not driven by hot new technical trends; we're building the hard tech that matters to recipients — integrations with mobile money rails and delivery in low-connectivity contexts.

You'll represent engineering at the senior leadership level and own the interface between engineering and team members who haven't worked heavily with a product development organization before. That means learning our programs and the realities of our field teams, and working with partner teams to build our development practices, whether building trust that an MVP is a starting point rather than a final answer, or helping teams see why it’s worth taking time out of their urgent delivery goals to give feedback on a demo or try something new.

As GiveDirectly scales, technology is what allows us to reach more people without breaking. Your leadership means getting more cash to the people who need it most.

Reports to: VP of Technology

Level
: Director

A venture-backed robotics startup in San Francisco is hiring its first Chief Technology Officer.

They are building a six-legged robot with magnetic feet that climbs metal structures to inspect and service critical infrastructure, high-voltage transmission towers, pipelines, tanks, bridges, and shipbuilding hulls. jobs.title: VP Transmission and Distribution
jobs.description:
Description

We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels heard and respected, and extending our culture of care so that every individual can reach their full potential. We want you to have a sense of belonging and feel valued for your contributions and the perspectives you bring.

Summary

The VP, Transmission & Distribution (T&D) is the P&L owner for the T&D business unit, with full accountability for revenue, margin, and cost. This role drives profitable growth of the business unit through disciplined operational execution and proactive business development. This role oversees all day-to-day project activities and the long-term strategic direction of the T&D business unit, including Transmission, Substation/Switchyard, and general high and medium voltage construction projects across the U.S. The VP is fully accountable for the business unit’s financial performance — revenue, margin, and cost — and serves as the primary client-facing leader for the T&D business.

The T&D business unit is responsible for standalone transmission and distribution projects that are independent of our core EPC projects. The work is primarily construction-focused, although there may be opportunities for the T&D business unit to support engineering and procurement activities as needed.

Working hand-in-hand with Business Development resources, this leader is responsible for identifying, pursuing, securing, negotiating, and executing construction contracts. The VP will build and maintain strong client relationships, grow the T&D construction pipeline, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards. Direct reports include Pre-Construction, Estimating, and Project Directors, who are accountable for the execution of T&D projects. The VP works collaboratively with Operations and support functions across the broader organization to ensure projects are appropriately staffed, including disciplined workforce planning and resource forecasting. This position reports to the SVP, U.S. EPC and T&D.

Preferred location is Denver, CO or Houston, TX. The role requires regular presence at RES corporate headquarters in Denver alongside frequent client and project site travel. Candidates outside these markets will be considered based on their ability to meet the travel requirements of the position.

Requirements

Owns full P&L accountability for the T&D business unit, including revenue, margin, cost management, and monthly financial forecasting; directly leads Pre-Construction, Estimating, and Project Directors responsible for project execution, and reports business unit financial performance to SVP, U.S. EPC and T&D.
Develops, reviews, and re-defines the business strategy for profitable growth of the business unit; responsible for a three-year business plan including HSQE, revenue, and profit targets.
Ensures projects are completed safely and according to the planned schedule and budget.
Ensures that environmental stewardship meets or exceeds contractual requirements and regional regulations.
Ensures that company management systems, including HSQE, stage gate, and project management processes, are followed and implemented.
Partners with Business Development resources to identify, pursue, and win new T&D project opportunities; leads or supports contract negotiations with owners and subcontractors.
Performs budget management, estimate reviews, budget preparation, and monthly status reviews.
Leads monthly project reviews for all business unit projects and reports on key project performance to Executive Leadership Team.
Leads Project Management and Senior T&D Management meetings for internal project status.
Identifies risks and opportunities to the monthly financial forecast and resolves all issues to mitigate risks and capture opportunities to improve business unit performance.
Leads workforce planning and resource forecasting for the T&D Construction business unit; works collaboratively with Operations and support functions across the organization to ensure projects are appropriately staffed; performs talent management, staffing reviews, and succession planning focused on leadership-level roles.
Travels for negotiations, project site visits, and internal and client meetings.
Serves as the primary client-facing executive for the T&D business; builds and maintains senior client relationships, proactively addresses concerns, resolves project issues, and finalizes change orders while protecting and growing the client relationship.
Attends work regularly and punctually, as scheduled or expected.
Complies with Employee Handbook, Code of Conduct, and Company Policies & Procedures.
Collaborates with external engineers, clients, and Pre-Construction to drive constructability into the project development process, ensuring designs are practical, safe, and optimized for efficient field execution.

Additional Responsibilities

Leads the T&D construction pursuit process; reviews and approves proposals, coordinates with Business Development on go/no-go decisions, and represents RES in client-facing proposal presentations. Maintains accountability for the T&D new contract award pipeline and reports regularly on business development progress and market opportunities to SVP, U.S. EPC and T&D
In collaboration with Commercial and Legal groups, prepare risk management and approval papers per the Stage-Gate and LOA requirements.
Assists in the development of standard substation designs in collaboration with Engineering to provide efficient, repeatable solutions for clients.
Drives innovation in construction methods and technology to improve safety, productivity, and project delivery outcomes.
Collaborates with HSQE, Commercial, PMO, Operational Excellence, and Engineering groups as required for process implementation and improvement.
Collaborates with the EPC business unit and support functions to ensure project execution consistency, as well as supporting EPC Pre-Construction on planning and estimating as required to support HV scopes for their projects.
For select projects, the T&D business unit may engage with engineering activities in support of client needs. This role ensures appropriate collaboration through Pre-Construction and other organizational functions to deploy the right engineering resources and expertise.

Safety

Presents, supports, and leads-by-example with a safety and quality-oriented attitude.
Leads by example to show that safety is the most important function, ensuring that all employees follow safe practices while working.
Accountable to continually reinforce safe behaviors and correct “at risk” behaviors.
Adheres to and ensures all site team members understands standard operating procedures.
Leads and supports the site team in technical, quality and safety, utilizing system in place.

Leadership

We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels heard and respected, and extending our culture of care so that every individual can reach their full potential. We want you to have a sense of belonging and feel valued for your contributions and the perspectives you bring.

Summary

The VP, Transmission & Distribution (T&D) is the P&L owner for the T&D business unit, with full accountability for revenue, margin, and cost. This role drives profitable growth of the business unit through disciplined operational execution and proactive business development. This role oversees all day-to-day project activities and the long-term strategic direction of the T&D business unit, including Transmission, Substation/Switchyard, and general high and medium voltage construction projects across the U.S. The VP is fully accountable for the business unit’s financial performance — revenue, margin, and cost — and serves as the primary client-facing leader for the T&D business.

The T&D business unit is responsible for standalone transmission and distribution projects that are independent of our core EPC projects. jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager, Fortary Platform based in United States.

This is a senior engineering leadership opportunity focused on building institutional-grade digital asset infrastructure.

You’ll lead multiple engineering teams responsible for custody, transaction authorization, key management, wallets, and blockchain integrations.

The role combines distributed systems, applied cryptography, security, and regulated financial technology.

You’ll own the technical architecture and roadmap for a distributed MPC custody platform built for institutional scale.

You’ll work closely with Product, Security, Business Development, and executive stakeholders to align technology with customer and regulatory needs.

As a hands-on leader, you’ll shape engineering practices, manage critical incidents, and develop high-performing engineering leaders.

The role offers the opportunity to influence a highly secure platform operating at the intersection of Web3 and institutional finance.

Accountabilities

Lead multiple engineering teams delivering custody, transaction authorization, key management, wallet infrastructure, and blockchain integration capabilities.
Own the architecture, technical strategy, and roadmap for a distributed MPC custody platform, including disaster recovery, governance, transaction policies, and security controls.
Partner with Product, Security, Business Development, and executive leadership to prioritize engineering investments based on customer, regulatory, security, and business requirements.
Support multiple product deployment models, including managed-platform and licensed-software environments.
Establish engineering practices that meet demanding security, compliance, resilience, and governance requirements as the platform progresses toward regulated financial-institution status.
Lead engineering response to production incidents, outages, security events, and sensitive key-management scenarios, ensuring effective resolution and continuous improvement.
Hire, mentor, and develop engineering managers and senior engineers while establishing a strong leadership culture across the organization.
Drive the effective adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices to improve productivity, development quality, and delivery across engineering teams.
Ensure technical decisions balance scalability, resilience, security, compliance, and long-term maintainability.

Requirements

10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading teams responsible for production-scale, secure distributed systems.
Proven experience owning large-scale, security-critical platforms from architectural design through production delivery and ongoing operation.
Deep expertise in modern cryptography and secure key-management technologies, particularly MPC, threshold signatures, Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).
Strong experience designing and operating cloud-native systems, including Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, observability, and resilient infrastructure.
Strong understanding of security and compliance frameworks relevant to regulated financial services, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, and AML/KYC, with awareness of regulatory environments such as SEC, CFTC, OCC, and MiCA.
Experience with digital asset infrastructure spanning areas such as custody, trading, staking, treasury management, and blockchain settlement.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical organizations while maintaining a high engineering and security bar.
Excellent communication skills, with the credibility to work effectively with executives, institutional customers, auditors, regulators, and other senior stakeholders.
Experience scaling an engineering organization toward a chartered or licensed financial entity is a strong advantage.
Background delivering both managed-service and licensed-software products is desirable.

Benefits

Senior leadership opportunity with significant ownership of technical strategy, architecture, and organizational growth.
Opportunity to build institutional-grade digital asset infrastructure across custody, trading, lending, staking, and treasury use cases.
Work at the intersection of blockchain technology, distributed systems, applied cryptography, and regulated finance.
Global, expert-led environment bringing together specialists across engineering, finance, economics, marketing, and law.
Opportunity to work closely with senior executives, institutional customers, security specialists, and regulatory stakeholders.
Strong focus on engineering innovation, security, resilience, and AI-assisted development.
Equal-opportunity workplace committed to diversity, inclusion, and hiring based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

You will be accountable for building resilient, secure, scalable, and cloud‑ready network platforms across campus, data center, colocation, hybrid, and cloud environments.

In this role, you will drive a cloud‑first, automation‑led network strategy, improve operational reliability and recovery, and strengthen governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) maturity. Network Architecture & Strategy

Establish enterprise standards for network design, client connectivity, resiliency, and security
Evaluate emerging networking technologies and recommend solutions that improve performance, scalability, reliability, and security

Lead the response to complex network incidents, including root‑cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions
Reduce operational risk by improving testing practices, recovery planning, and standardization of connectivity models
Monitor network performance, utilization, and capacity; sponsor optimization initiatives such as traffic engineering and QoS

Cloud, Automation & Modernization

Lead execution of the cloud and hybrid network strategy, including hybrid connectivity, cloud networking patterns, and cost‑optimization initiatives
Drive adoption of network automation and Infrastructure as Code, leveraging tools such as Ansible, Python, and SDN technologies
Ensure network provisioning, configuration management, and change execution are automated to improve efficiency and reduce manual errors
Establish cloud‑specific operational models, including monitoring, incident management, and financial governance

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Own network‑related governance, risk, and compliance responsibilities
Standardize network documentation, controls, and audit evidence
Track audit findings, remediation actions, and control effectiveness through structured governance forums
Partner with security, risk, and audit teams to ensure ongoing regulatory readiness

Leadership, Delivery & Vendor Management

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of network operations and engineering professionals, with planned growth as demand increases
Set priorities, performance goals, and accountability across the organization
Lead network‑related programs and initiatives, including upgrades, migrations, and technology refreshes
Define project scope, timelines, resources, and budgets to ensure delivery on schedule and within constraints
Evaluate network vendors, support contract negotiations, and manage strategic vendor relationships
Ensure high‑quality network documentation, diagrams, procedures, and knowledge sharing
Communicate network risks, initiatives, and incidents effectively to senior leadership, including executive‑ready presentations (PowerPoint, Visio)

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in network engineering, operations, or infrastructure leadership roles within large, global enterprises
Demonstrated experience leading and developing technical teams
Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent practical experience
Experience supporting regulated or highly audited environments

Talents Needed for Success

Deep expertise in enterprise network architecture and operations
Expert‑level knowledge of networking protocols and technologies, including: - TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS
VLAN, STP
Network security protocols (IPsec, SSL/TLS)
Strong experience with data center, hybrid, and cloud networking
Extensive experience with enterprise network devices and vendors
In‑depth understanding of network security principles, including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and access control
Proven ability to lead incident response, root‑cause analysis, and operational improvement programs
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills
Demonstrated experience driving organizational process improvement and change

Nice to Have Skills

Experience with Infoblox, Guardicore, or similar network/IPAM/security platforms
Prior ownership of client connectivity platforms or services
Experience building centralized network topology or observability repositories
Advanced network certifications (CCIE, JNCIE)

You own the full pipeline from raw signal to real-time AI retrieval — not just one piece of the stack
Your science teams generate inferences across all of Amazon's businesses, not a single vertical
You partner with 10+ organizations and influence without authority at the most senior levels
You build for conversational AI agents that need to recall the right memory in the right moment at real-time speed

The systems you own are already at massive scale and growing fast — this isn't a roadmap on a whiteboard

If you want to shape how AI understands and remembers hundreds of millions of customers, and you thrive leading science and engineering teams through ambiguity at scale, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities

Lead and grow multiple science and engineering teams that generate, store, and serve customer inferences across all Amazon businesses — building the AI-ready representations that power personalized experiences for hundreds of millions of customers.

Define and execute the technical strategy for family and household understanding — identifying the important people, pets, and vehicles in each customer's life and enabling personalized recommendations for each.

Drive memory quality at scale: establish precision and recall targets, build evaluation frameworks, and continuously improve the accuracy of both explicit memories (what customers tell us) and inferred memories (what we learn from their behavior).

Define privacy-by-design principles for customer memory: ensure every inference respects consent, deletion promises, regulatory requirements, and customer trust while maximizing personalization value.

Establish cross-business data governance standards — authoring schemas, onboarding processes, and quality gates that allow dozens of businesses to contribute customer signals into a unified system without compromising data integrity.

Hire, develop, and retain world-class applied scientists and engineers, fostering a culture of scientific rigor, rapid experimentation, and customer obsession.

Customer 360 is Amazon's central memory system. Our mission: when a customer interacts with any part of Amazon, every other part reflects that understanding immediately. jobs.title: Senior Information Security Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

The Senior Information Security Engineering Manager is a strategic leadership role responsible for protecting the organization’s critical data, applications, identities, and emerging technology platforms. This position leads security initiatives across data and application security, identity and access management, and AI security, ensuring effective controls are in place to reduce risk and strengthen the organization’s overall security posture.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with leadership and collaboration skills, partnering across IT and cybersecurity teams to advance security capabilities, enhance privileged access controls, support secure development practices, and address risks associated with emerging technologies.

What You’ll Do

Data & Application Security

Establish and maintain technical controls that protect data and applications across on-premises, cloud, and remote-access environments
Align data protection and application security policies with corporate governance and risk management requirements
Evaluate and implement controls that reduce risk from insider threats and data breaches, in coordination with security leadership and stakeholders
Conduct data and application discovery to identify at-risk data and validate storage integrity
Test and maintain business rules governing data use, handling, and access
Recommend improvements that enforce least privilege and strengthen application security without degrading user experience
Analyze systems and data sources for accidental, malicious, or unauthorized activity

Secure Coding & Application Security Testing

Maintain and administer the organization's Secure Coding Standard, including periodic review and updates
Administer SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling, and track code-level vulnerability remediation against defined SLAs
Conduct security reviews of high-risk or security-critical code and application components
Make scoping determinations on whether development and automation initiatives fall within SDLC and Secure Coding Standard governance
Lead secure coding gap assessments across development teams and evaluate tooling strategy to close systemic gaps
Provide secure coding training and tooling to development teams
Report on secure coding risk posture and remediation timelines to leadership

Identity & Access Management (IAM) Security

Administer and maintain PAM platforms, including vaulting, privileged session management, and access policy configuration
Configure and manage privileged account controls, entitlements, and workflows within PAM tooling
Monitor privileged session activity and investigate anomalous or unauthorized privileged access
Drive improvements to the organization's identity and access security posture, including authentication controls, access governance, and identity risk reduction
Develop and maintain a roadmap for maturing IAM and PAM security controls in line with risk and regulatory requirements
Conduct periodic reviews of privileged and elevated access to confirm alignment with least-privilege and policy requirements
Partner with identity operations and IT teams that perform standard account provisioning and deprovisioning to ensure privileged accounts are onboarded and offboarded accurately in PAM tooling
Maintain and enforce IAM- and PAM-related policies, standards, and exception processes
Provide audit and examiner support for identity and privileged access controls

Emerging Technology Security

Support evaluation of security risks associated with AI/GenAI and other emerging technologies, including model access and data exposure
Partner with GRC to maintain risk register entries for AI-related and other emerging technology threats
Help evaluate security tooling and controls as new technology-driven asset categories are introduced

General

Serve on a distributed security team responsible for maintaining technical controls across the above areas
Maintain understanding of business processes to support enterprise data protection, access, and technology risk management
Engage with business units to understand their risk posture and tolerance, and support their objectives securely
Manage security projects from inception to completion, on time and within budget
Build working relationships with engineering, IT, incident response, SOC, and software engineering teams
Support the organization and leadership team, including during periods of change

Requirements For Success

Education:
Bachelor's degree preferred in information assurance, computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.

Experience:
5-8+ years of cybersecurity or information technology experience

Required Skills

Hands-on experience administering privileged access management (PAM) platforms (e.g., vaulting, session management, policy configuration)
Experience advancing identity and access management (IAM) security programs, such as authentication controls, access governance, or identity risk reduction
Familiarity with administering or overseeing directory services, databases, role-based access, DLP, data classification, and governance solutions
Experience with secure coding principles and standards (e.g., OWASP Top 10) and application security testing tools (SAST, DAST, SCA)
2+ years of experience with data protection management solutions; endpoint, network, or application security experience preferred
Experience with one or more of: CRI, CIS18, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) preferred
Strong written and verbal communication skills across all levels of the organization
Understanding of data protection, application security, and access control principles and frameworks
Ability to prioritize and complete tasks within defined SLAs
Sound judgment and the ability to make timely decisions in complex situations
High degree of integrity, trustworthiness, and professionalism

Preferred Skills

5-8+ years of security systems administration experience, including 2+ years of hands-on data protection or PAM practitioner experience
One or more of: CISSP, CIPP, CISA, CRISC, CDPSE, GSEC
Experience developing or contributing to an IAM/PAM security roadmap or maturity program
Experience leading secure coding gap assessments or maturity initiatives across development teams
Familiarity with AI security posture management (AISPM) platforms or other emerging-technology risk evaluation tools
Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as PCI, FFIEC, SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, and GLBA

Conditions of Employment

This position manages employees and is responsible for the coaching, development, and performance management of those employees.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

The Opportunity at Altana

As the Senior Director of Platform Engineering, you will own the foundation that the entire Altana engineering organization builds on: the cloud infrastructure that runs our products and the developer experience that determines how fast and how safely we ship. You will lead a multidisciplinary organization spanning Cloud Engineering, Developer Experience, Site Reliability, and DevSecOps / Release Engineering — with end-to-end ownership of our build, test, and release pipelines.

This is a moment of real transformation in how software is built. We are reorganizing our engineering practice around an AI-first, agent-first model, where AI coding harnesses and autonomous agents are first-class participants in the software development lifecycle. We are looking for a leader who has done this work before — someone who has built and scaled developer experience and platform organizations, and who has direct, hands-on experience and strong, well-formed opinions about agentic coding, AI-assisted development, and what it takes to make an engineering org dramatically more productive.

You will set the technical strategy, build and develop the team, and personally raise the bar on engineering excellence. You will be measured by the reliability and cost-efficiency of our platforms, the velocity and happiness of every engineer who depends on them, and how effectively Altana adopts AI across the development lifecycle.

Key areas under your stewardship

Cloud Engineering:
You will design, manage, and secure the multi-cloud infrastructure that powers our products — architectures that are scalable, flexible, resilient, and cost-performant across both commercial and government-compliant deployments. This includes the data platforms that support large-scale data processing, analytics, and machine learning, enabling our teams to work with world-scale datasets and build data-driven solutions.

Developer Experience:
You will own the infrastructure and tooling the engineering organization relies on every day — our monorepo, CI/CD platform, build systems, local development environments, and internal tooling — and the end-to-end experience of working in our codebase from clone to production. This is the center of gravity for the role: driving Developer Acceleration across the board and making AI-first, agent-first development the default way Altana engineers work.

Site Reliability:
You will ensure our systems are reliable, available, performant, and efficient. The SRE function establishes and monitors SLOs and error budgets, owns observability, drives toil reduction, and leads incident management so our services run smoothly and recover quickly from disruption.

DevOps / Release Engineering:
You will bridge development and operations, automating and optimizing the software delivery lifecycle from commit to deploy. Through robust CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code, your team ensures new features and updates ship rapidly, safely, and consistently.

Your Responsibilities

Technical Strategy & Execution

Define and own a clear, multi-year technical strategy for Platform Engineering, ensuring the team stays focused on the highest-leverage work while advancing long-term architectural goals.
Set the reference architecture and standards for cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and developer tooling, balancing immediate operational needs against strategic investment.
Make and guide key decisions on scalability, performance, security, and cost, working closely with engineers on the hardest problems rather than from a distance.
Lead build-vs-buy and platform investment decisions, including which tools, vendors, and open-source technologies to adopt across the SDLC.

Developer Experience & Acceleration

Own the Developer Acceleration program: instrument and continuously improve developer workflows, driving measurable gains in build times, PR cycle time, flaky-test rate, and deployment frequency (DORA / SPACE).
Drive an AI-first, agent-first transformation of the software development lifecycle — making AI coding harnesses and agents reliable, governed, first-class participants in how Altana writes, reviews, tests, and ships code.
Set strategy for integrating AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and agent frameworks) into CI/CD, code review, local development, and release pipelines at scale.
Establish how AI-assisted and agent-generated code is reviewed, tested, secured, and governed — including LLM-aware testing strategies, evaluation and guardrails, and the supporting context engineering and tooling that make agents effective in a large monorepo.
Treat the engineering organization as your customer: gather requirements from application teams, translate vague friction into well-scoped platform work, and prove impact through before/after measurement.
Evolve our monorepo strategy — code organization, dependency management, build caching, and testing patterns — so it works consistently across our multi-cloud and compliance-constrained environments.

Operational Excellence

Establish and continuously improve best practices for monitoring, incident response, automation, and performance optimization across production and the delivery pipeline.
Drive a culture of ownership, resilience, and accountability to ensure high availability, performance, and security in our production environments.
Own reliability and cost across cloud infrastructure; conduct regular post-incident reviews and capacity planning to anticipate and mitigate risk before it reaches customers.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

Partner across product, engineering, security, data science, and commercial teams to align platform investment with business objectives.
Communicate trade-offs, constraints, and roadmap clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and represent Platform Engineering to senior leadership.
Manage relationships with external vendors and partners, including cloud providers and tooling vendors.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary organization of engineers and managers across software, infrastructure, reliability, and developer tooling.
Manage distributed teams across multiple time zones, maintaining alignment and a cohesive culture in a remote-friendly environment.
Recruit top-tier talent and act as a top-notch recruiter yourself; foster professional development, recognize outstanding performance, and address underperformance constructively and in a timely way.

About You

Experience building, leading, and scaling best-in-class platform and/or developer experience organizations, ideally in a rapidly scaling environment, including leading managers and senior engineers.
10+ years of real-world experience developing or managing complex engineering systems, with significant time spent owning developer experience, platform engineering, or the build/test/release pipeline end to end.
A proven track record of driving developer experience and developer productivity across an organization — you can point to concrete before/after outcomes (build times, PR cycle time, deployment frequency, reliability) from initiatives you led.
Direct, hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development — AI coding harnesses, agent-first / AI-first workflows, and coding agents — and clear, well-formed opinions about how they change code review, testing, pipeline design, and engineering org structure.
Deep expertise with CI/CD systems (Buildkite, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) and a demonstrated ability to scale them, ideally in a monorepo at scale.
Strong software engineering fundamentals — you design well-architected systems and lead from the front, not just from the org chart.
Production experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform / OpenTofu).
A track record tackling large-scale infrastructure in support of fast-paced ML/AI-enabled products and services.
Experience designing tooling and patterns that work across multiple clouds or isolated / air-gapped and compliance-constrained environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, or similar) is a strong plus.
Strong sense of shared ownership, a collaborative disposition, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
You don’t hesitate to go to the dentist during the work day, but you’re also the person on your laptop working on the team’s hardest problems to relax.

This role can be fully remote or based in any of our US Altana hub locations, with hybrid work flexibility: Brooklyn, NY, Washington, DC, Boston, MA, or San Francisco, CA

$295,000 - $345,000 USD

Benefits

Altana also offers either a discretionary bonus or a variable compensation plan depending on the role. Additionally, Altana offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Flexible Time Off: Altana operates with a Flexible Time Off (FTO) policy that gives you agency over your own time off so you can maximize your work-life balance.
Parental Leave: We offer industry leading Paid Parental Leave (PPL), providing 14 weeks of leave for non-birthing, adoptive, and foster parents and up to 26 weeks of leave for birthing parents, all paid at 100% of your base salary.
Health Benefits: We have a full suite of medical, vision, and dental benefits with generous employer contributions, designed to give you flexibility and choice for your individual health situation. Our high deductible health plan is 100% employer paid for employees and supplemented with an employer contribution to your Health Savings Account (HSA). There is also a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) option.
Supplemental Benefits: Altana provides life, short- and long-term disability, and AD&D insurance coverage, all at no cost to you, so you know that you and your loved ones are covered in case of an emergency.
401(k) Savings: Save for and invest in your future using our Guideline 401(k) retirement savings program.

jobs.title: Vice President, Engineering and Technology
jobs.description:
Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Introduction – Why This Role Matters for Insitu

Insitu is redefining the future of unmanned aviation, delivering autonomous vehicle systems and mission solutions that support critical intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) missions for global defense and security customers. As our Vice President, Engineering and Technology, you will be the senior technical leader guiding the next generation of Insitu’s platforms, payloads, autonomy, and mission services—shaping how our customers sense, decide, and act in the most demanding environments.

This is a high‑impact, enterprise‑wide role that combines technology strategy, engineering leadership, and operational integration. You will report directly to the CEO, lead both Engineering and Flight Operations through your department directors, and set the technical direction that underpins Insitu’s growth, competitiveness, and long‑term innovation roadmap.

Job Description Summary

The Vice President of Engineering and Technology is the company’s senior technical leader and primary technology strategist. This role owns the long‑term technology vision and roadmap for our autonomous systems portfolio and ensures that major business and investment decisions are grounded in deep technical insight and aligned with company strategy and customer mission needs.

The VP, Engineering and Technology sets and communicates the technology direction, architects the product and platform strategy, prioritizes R&D and capital investments, and maintains a coherent “system‑of‑systems” vision across platforms, payloads, autonomy, ground systems, and data/software.

This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer and is a key member of the executive leadership team, acting as the company’s chief technical authority and external technology ambassador.

The Engineering and Flight Operations departments both report directly to this position. The VP, Engineering and Technology provides executive leadership and guidance to both organizations and is accountable for integrating Engineering and Flight Operations to deliver safe, reliable, and innovative autonomous vehicle systems and mission services that meet customer, quality, regulatory, and contractual requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Vision, Strategy & Architecture
Own and continuously evolve the company’s multi‑year technology vision and roadmap for unmanned and autonomous systems, aligned with long‑range business plans, customer mission outcomes, and innovation priorities.
Lead portfolio‑level technology and architecture decisions (e.g., make/buy/partner, modularity vs. integration, open architectures) to optimize capability, schedule, lifecycle cost, and technical risk.
Translate emerging tech trends (autonomy/AI, advanced sensors, secure networking, cloud‑enabled mission services, digital engineering) into concrete, prioritized roadmaps and investment themes.
Chair key technical governance forums (e.g., Architecture Review Board, Design Authority reviews) to maintain technical integrity, reuse, and common standards across programs.
Innovation, R&D & Productization
Drive a focused, high‑impact R&D portfolio aligned with the technology strategy and customer needs, making clear go/hold/stop decisions on major technology bets.
Guide the maturation of technologies from concept and prototype through flight test, production, and in‑service evolution.
Sponsor and review research and case studies on leading‑edge technologies, identifying differentiating capabilities and ensuring rapid learning cycles (demo, test, iterate).
Chief Technical Authority & Governance
Serve as the company’s ultimate technical authority for key design and architecture decisions, technical risk acceptance, and technology trade‑offs.
Establish and track key technical KPIs/OKRs (e.g., defect rates, design cycle times, test coverage, reliability metrics) and drive continuous improvement based on data.
Engineering & Flight Organization Leadership
Lead and integrate a multi‑disciplinary Engineering organization (Systems, Software, AI/Autonomy, Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Payloads, Test) to deliver cohesive, high‑impact solutions for global defense and security customers.
Scale and structure the Engineering and Flight Operations organizations to meet strategic growth; assign authority and responsibility to department directors and their leadership teams, and monitor execution.
Build and maintain a strong technical ladder, including Principal/Chief Engineers, to provide deep expertise, mentorship, and design leadership across programs.
Provide strategic oversight and technical direction through the Director, Flight Operations to ensure operations (flight test, training, deployed missions) are tightly integrated with the technology roadmap and product strategy
Customer, Market & Ecosystem Engagement
Engage directly with key customers, end‑users, and partners to understand mission problems, shape the technology roadmap around real operational needs, and advocate for investment priorities.
Represent the company’s technology strategy and capabilities at customer briefings, industry events, standards bodies, and with key suppliers, serving as an external technical thought leader.
Provide authoritative technical input to major pursuits and strategic partnerships, including solution architectures, discriminators, and risk/feasibility assessments.
Executive Leadership, Culture & Governance
Partner with Programs, Operations, Product Lines, Business Development, and Finance to ensure technology strategy and engineering execution support growth, profitability, and long‑range business plans.
Lead, mentor, and inspire Engineering and Flight Operations leadership and their teams, reinforcing a culture of technical excellence, safety, integrity, and accountability.
Build and sustain an inclusive, high‑performance culture that attracts, develops, and retains top technical and operational talent.
Own Engineering and Flight Operations budgets and resource plans, ensuring investments and staffing align with strategic priorities and program commitments.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a closely related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

Experience

Extensive experience in aerospace, defense, and/or autonomous systems, with significant time in senior technical leadership roles (e.g., Vice President, Chief Engineer, Head of Engineering, or equivalent).
Demonstrated experience defining and executing technology strategy and technical roadmaps for complex, software‑enabled hardware products.
Proven track record partnering with Programs/Operations and Business Development to deliver on schedule, on budget, and to spec for government or highly regulated customers.
Demonstrated success managing sizable departmental budgets and contributing to annual operating plans and long‑range business planning.
Ability to engage credibly at a deep technical level (e.g., architecture trade‑offs, algorithm performance, system safety, test strategies) while maintaining a portfolio‑level strategic view.

Leadership & Interpersonal Skills

Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high‑performing technical organizations in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments.
Strong cross‑functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders from engineering, operations, programs, finance, and business development.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics in clear business and operational terms to executives, customers, and partners.
Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, make sound decisions with incomplete data, and drive clarity, focus, and accountability.

Desired Qualifications

Ability to obtain or maintain a Secret Security Clearance
Prior experience as a senior technology leader (e.g., VP‑level Engineering/Technology, Chief Engineer) in aerospace, defense, or autonomous systems organizations.
Deep familiarity with small tactical UAS, ISR mission concepts, and associated ground and data systems.
Hands‑on or leadership experience in autonomy/AI for UAS, advanced payloads, mission systems, or secure communications networks.
Demonstrated experience with Profit & Loss responsibility or strong P&L fluency in a technology‑ and operations‑intensive business.
Familiarity with export control environments (e.g., ITAR/EAR) and experience working with U.S. and/or allied defense and security customers.

This role is eligible for hybrid work. There is a strong preference that this individual is on site at our facilities in Bingen, WA 3+ days/week. The ability to travel is required - travel needs will vary based on customer/partnership opportunities, timing of events, etc.

Insitu also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability programs and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire.

jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering & AI
jobs.description:
Vice President of Engineering & AI

SourceNow | Remote – United States | Full-Time

The Opportunity

SourceNow is seeking an exceptional Vice President of Engineering & AI to lead the continued evolution of our engineering, AI, technology, and IT capabilities and help build the next generation of our enterprise workforce technology platform, SN1.

This is not a traditional technology executive role. We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader who still builds.

The successful candidate must be equally comfortable setting engineering and AI strategy with executive leadership and opening the codebase to personally write production-quality code, review pull requests, design APIs, troubleshoot performance issues, architect systems, and build new AI-powered capabilities. If you have moved completely away from coding and hands-on engineering, this is not the right opportunity.

We are looking for a builder, engineer, architect, AI practitioner, product thinker, and technology leader who can move seamlessly between executive strategy and hands-on engineering execution.

Our objective is to continue evolving SN1 into an AI-first enterprise workforce technology platform where AI, automation, data, engineering, and conversational experiences fundamentally improve how organizations manage their workforce.

This Is a Hands-On Engineering Role

Technical credibility is essential.

The VP of Engineering & AI must remain a current software engineer and personally participate in engineering and product development.

You should be comfortable:

Writing production-quality code
Personally contributing to software engineering
Designing and building full-stack applications
Building frontend and backend systems
Designing and consuming REST APIs
Reviewing code and engineering pull requests
Troubleshooting complex production issues
Designing scalable application architecture
Building scalable data models
Improving application performance
Working with cloud infrastructure
Rapidly prototyping product concepts
Building and deploying AI applications
Taking features from concept through production
Establishing engineering and coding standards
Working directly alongside engineers when needed

We want an executive who can lead engineers because they understand engineering firsthand—not because they used to engineer years ago.

AI Engineering & AI Product Development

AI will be a core component of SourceNow's product and technology strategy.

This leader will help establish and execute our AI strategy, AI engineering architecture, AI development practices, and AI product roadmap.

We are specifically looking for candidates with hands-on experience building and deploying production AI applications, not simply managing AI initiatives.

Experience may include:

Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)
AI application development
AI agents and agentic workflows
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Tool calling and function calling
Prompt and context engineering
Structured model outputs
AI evaluation and testing
Embeddings
Vector databases
Semantic search
AI workflow orchestration
Model selection and routing
AI data pipelines
AI observability and monitoring
AI security, permissions, and guardrails
Responsible AI
AI reliability
Cost and latency optimization
Enterprise AI integrations

We want someone who understands the difference between creating an impressive AI demonstration and engineering reliable AI products that enterprise customers can safely use in production.

Full-Stack Engineering

This role requires deep experience across modern full-stack software engineering.

You should be comfortable working across:

Frontend Engineering:

JavaScript, TypeScript, modern frameworks, component-based applications, responsive interfaces, and scalable frontend architecture.

Backend Engineering:

APIs, services, authentication, authorization, business logic, distributed systems, application performance, and scalable backend architecture.

Data Engineering:

Relational databases, data modeling, query optimization, analytics, data pipelines, reporting infrastructure, and AI-oriented data architecture.

Cloud Engineering & DevOps:

Cloud-native architecture, CI/CD, deployment, scalability, monitoring, observability, reliability, security, infrastructure, and disaster recovery.

Integration Engineering:

REST APIs, webhooks, SFTP, middleware, file integrations, authentication, data synchronization, and enterprise system integrations.

Experience integrating with HRIS, HCM, ERP, payroll, timekeeping, financial, staffing, VMS, workforce management, or other enterprise technology systems is especially valuable.

Engineering, Technology & IT Leadership

The VP of Engineering & AI will lead across four interconnected areas:

Engineering. AI. Product Technology. IT.

Key areas of responsibility include:

Software engineering
Full-stack engineering
AI engineering
AI product development
Enterprise IT
Cloud infrastructure
Application and data architecture
Cybersecurity
APIs and enterprise integrations
DevOps and deployment
Engineering operations
Product technology strategy
Technical hiring
Engineering leadership
IT security and governance
SOC 2 technology controls
Business continuity and disaster recovery

This individual will help ensure SourceNow's engineering systems, AI capabilities, IT infrastructure, cloud environments, development environments, architecture, security controls, and enterprise technology are scalable, secure, and reliable.

Product & AI Innovation

Technology at SourceNow exists to solve customer problems.

You will partner with executive leadership, Product, Engineering, customers, and business teams to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions.

You will help:

Define the technical roadmap for SN1
Establish our AI and engineering roadmap
Translate business strategy into technology architecture
Rapidly prototype new ideas
Evaluate emerging AI technologies
Improve engineering velocity
Improve platform scalability and reliability
Manage technical debt intelligently
Make build-versus-buy decisions
Strengthen enterprise integrations
Improve development processes
Build infrastructure capable of supporting continued growth

Potential AI initiatives include:

Conversational workforce management
AI reporting and analytics
Intelligent job creation
AI talent matching
Supplier intelligence
AI-powered workflow automation
Predictive workforce intelligence
AI agents
AI-powered customer experiences

We also expect you to bring AI and engineering ideas we have not yet considered.

Engineering Leadership

This is an executive leadership role and a hands-on engineering position.

You will:

Lead and mentor software engineers
Recruit exceptional engineering and AI talent
Establish engineering standards
Improve code-review practices
Lead architecture decisions
Create accountability around delivery
Improve engineering velocity and quality
Develop engineering talent
Strengthen technical documentation
Build a culture of experimentation and execution
Remain personally involved in critical engineering and AI initiatives

We want someone who raises the technical capability of everyone around them while remaining close enough to the technology to personally build when necessary.

What We're Looking For

Strong candidates will likely bring:

10+ years of software engineering experience
Significant full-stack engineering experience
Current hands-on coding ability
Meaningful hands-on AI/LLM engineering experience
Experience building and deploying production AI applications
Experience leading software engineering teams
Experience with enterprise SaaS applications
Strong cloud architecture experience
Strong API and enterprise integration experience
Experience with scalable data architecture
Knowledge of modern IT environments
Experience with application and cloud security
Experience shipping enterprise production software
Experience recruiting and mentoring technical talent
Experience as a VP of Engineering, VP of Technology, Engineering Director, CTO, Head of Engineering, or similar technology leader is valuable.
Experience within HR technology, workforce management, staffing technology, VMS, HCM, ERP, payroll, or enterprise SaaS is a plus but not required.

We are interested in hiring an exceptional engineering and AI leader who can learn workforce technology than a technology leader who already knows the industry.

The Person We're Looking For:

A Builder. You still love writing code and creating software.
An AI Practitioner. You have personally built AI applications.
An Architect. You understand how today's engineering decisions affect tomorrow's platform.
A Product Thinker. You connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.
A Leader. You can recruit, mentor, challenge, and inspire strong engineers.
Entrepreneurial. You thrive in an environment where ideas can move quickly from discussion to prototype to production.
Pragmatic. You know when to build, when to buy, when to iterate, and when not to over-engineer.
The Builder Test

Before applying, ask yourself:

What have I personally built recently?

What AI systems have I personally built?

How frequently do I write code today?

Would I be excited to spend several hours tomorrow debugging and writing production code?

If the answer to that last question is yes, we want to talk to you.

Why SourceNow

Workforce technology is entering a period of fundamental change. AI creates an opportunity to move enterprise software beyond traditional menus, forms, dashboards, and workflows.

Software can understand intent.
Data can become conversational.
AI agents can automate workflows.
Technology can actively help users make better decisions.

SourceNow intends to be at the forefront of that transition.

We are looking for a technology leader who wants to help us build it.

Not observe it. Not advise from the sidelines. Build it.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Cyberinfrastructure, Software & Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Job Description

The Ocean Observatories Initiative (OOI) is seeking a Senior Manager, Cyberinfrastructure, Software & Cybersecurity
to provide Facility-level leadership for OOI cybersecurity, cyberinfrastructure performance and oversight, and software development. Reporting to the OOI Senior Program Manager in the OOI Program Management Office (PMO), this position is the principal OOI voice for cyberinfrastructure, software, and cybersecurity to NSF, OOI governance and advisory bodies, reviewers, and other stakeholders.

The Senior Manager owns the OOI Cybersecurity Plan and associated risks, provides program-level direction and oversight for OOI software development, establishes and tracks OOI-wide CI/CS requirements and activities, and integrates status and performance information from the Data Center, software development team, and Implementing Organizations into clear management and sponsor reporting. Day-to-day management of the software development team remains with the Software Development Manager, who works under the priorities and direction established by the Senior Manager.

This is a senior technical and program-management position focused on reliable sustainment, cybersecurity compliance, software-team leadership, performance oversight, risk management, and effective communication across a distributed research facility. The role requires enough technical depth to understand and challenge proposed approaches, develop practical plans, make informed decisions, and occasionally work directly with technical staff on difficult issues.

The position is not the day-to-day manager of OOI Data Center operations. The OOI Data Center Program Manager is a key partner and independently manages Data Center hardware, routine system operations, infrastructure maintenance, patching and upgrades, backups, and related operational activities. The Senior Manager relies on that operational expertise, gathers status and performance information as needed, integrates it with software-development and Implementing Organization activities, and provides the OOI Senior Program Manager and stakeholders with the overall CI/CS/software picture.

Similarly, the Senior Manager is not the day-to-day manager of the OOI software development team. The Software Development Manager retains responsibility for day-to-day management of the developers, work execution, staff supervision, and coordination of development activities. The Senior Manager establishes OOI software priorities, requirements, budgets, schedules, and overall technical and programmatic direction; reviews progress and performance; and works with the Software Development Manager to ensure that development activities support OOI-wide priorities.

The Senior Manager establishes Facility-wide CI and cybersecurity requirements and works through OOI PIs, Program Managers including the Data Center Program Manager, and technical leads to drive implementation and corrective action. Unresolved issues are elevated to the OOI Senior Program Manager and Principal Investigator as necessary. Scientific data QA/QC leadership remains with the OOI Data Manager supported by the appropriate OOI scientific and Implementing Organization functions.

Essential Functions & Duties

Own and maintain the OOI Cybersecurity Program and lead implementation of cybersecurity activities required by NSF and WHOI, translating requirements into practical OOI-wide plans, actions, schedules, and reporting.
Identify, assess, track, and report cybersecurity risks in the OOI risk register; define and monitor mitigation and corrective actions and ensure significant risks and unresolved issues are elevated in a timely manner.
Establish and coordinate implementation of OOI-wide cyberinfrastructure and cybersecurity requirements. Work with IO PIs and Program Managers including the Data Center Program Manager, and technical leads to resolve deficiencies and drive corrective action.
Provide program-level direction and oversight for the OOI software development organization, including establishment of priorities, requirements, technical direction, schedules, budgets, contracts/statements of work, and performance expectations. Work through the Software Development Manager, who retains responsibility for day-to-day team management, work assignments, personnel supervision, and execution. Monitor progress and performance and resolve or elevate issues as needed. Provide Facility-level oversight of the systems used to ingest, process, store, archive, secure, and deliver OOI science and engineering data. Monitor appropriate performance measures and work with responsible operational leads to address adverse trends or deficiencies.
Gather and synthesize status, metrics, accomplishments, upcoming work, resource needs, problems, risks, and corrective actions from the Data Center Program Manager, software development team, and IOs into concise reporting for OOI leadership and sponsors.
Serve as the Facility-level CI/CS/software representative to NSF, the OOI Facility Board (OOIFB), the OOIFB Data Systems Committee (DSC), external reviewers and auditors, scientists, technical partners, and other stakeholders.
Develop near- and mid-term CI, software, and cybersecurity plans and contribute associated scope, schedule, budget, licensing, lifecycle/refresh, and subcontractor needs to OOI annual work plans and other program-planning activities, with emphasis on sustainment and targeted, cost-effective improvements.
Coordinate program-level communication, follow-up, and reporting for significant CI or cybersecurity incidents and systemic issues while operational response remains with the responsible Data Center or IO technical leads.
Maintain sufficient technical engagement to evaluate proposed approaches, challenge assumptions, make sound technical/programmatic decisions, ensure appropriate documentation is maintained, and work hands-on with technical staff when useful.

Required Experience & Education

Master’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and substantial professional experience, in computer science, information systems, cybersecurity, software engineering, engineering, computational science, or a related field.
Demonstrated leadership of complex cyberinfrastructure, software, cybersecurity, information-technology, or scientific data-system activities in a multi-organizational environment.
Demonstrated experience leading or overseeing software-development activities and/or subcontracted technical teams, including establishing priorities and requirements, work planning, technical direction, schedules, budgets, contracts or statements of work, performance oversight, and progress reporting. Experience developing, implementing, or overseeing cybersecurity plans, requirements, risk-management activities, corrective actions, and compliance obligations in a research, academic, government, or comparable environment.
Technical breadth sufficient to work effectively across software development, enterprise systems, networks, databases, APIs, identity/access management, system administration, vulnerability management, backups, data storage, and data delivery. Deep expertise in every area is not required.

jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

MMG is modernizing the technology backbone behind our insurance platforms, digital experiences, and data, and we're looking for a Director of Platform Engineering to lead that work. 

You'll own the infrastructure, cloud, DevOps, and reliability capabilities that let our technology teams build, deploy, and operate with speed and confidence, across a hybrid environment running Microsoft Azure alongside on-premises infrastructure. You'll also help shape how governed, agentic AI gets safely built into how we work: real production impact, with the right controls in place. 

You'll lead a team of about five infrastructure and platform engineers, report to the CIO, and sit at the table with Product Engineering, Cybersecurity, Data, and Delivery leadership. Expect real ownership, hands-on technical involvement, and a genuine mandate to modernize. 

This is a remote role 
with quarterly travel to our Presque Isle, ME office and after-hours availability for major incidents and critical releases. The successful candidate must reside in Maine, Massachusetts, Georgia, Pennsylvania, New Hampshire, Virginia, Vermont, South Carolina, Florida, Texas and Missouri to be considered for this opportunity. 
​​​​

What You'll Own:

DevOps and delivery platforms: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment automation, deployment patterns, release tooling, and self-service paths from source control to production
Cloud and infrastructure: Microsoft Azure foundations, on-prem compute and storage, virtualization, networking, identity, backup, recovery, and cost transparency
Reliability and operations: monitoring, observability, incident response, disaster recovery, and eliminating recurring failures
Governed agentic AI: approved model and tool access, secure agent execution, identity and permissions, cost controls, and human approval points for agent-assisted engineering, testing, incident response, and operations
Team and vendors: coaching and developing your team, setting engineering standards, and holding infrastructure, cloud, and AI vendors accountable

First-year priorities: 

Build an authoritative DevOps and platform roadmap covering CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment automation, and observability
Stand up a governed agentic AI roadmap, from reference patterns and access controls through staged production adoption
Fix the most significant environment, deployment, backup, and reliability problems affecting critical services
Reduce manual, ticket-driven work and recurring infrastructure incidents
Assess and strengthen the platform team's structure, skills, and documentation

Essential Capabilities:

Has led a material DevOps improvement across infrastructure and software-delivery teams, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment automation, observability, release engineering, developer self-service, and production operating models
Can design and operate internal platform capabilities that increase team autonomy while preserving security, reliability, consistency, and accountability
Can evaluate and implement governed agentic AI capabilities for technology operations and translate governance requirements into practical architecture, permissions, telemetry, evaluation, human oversight, and operating controls
Has led and operated hybrid infrastructure spanning public cloud and on-premises environments, with strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure and Microsoft infrastructure technologies
Can diagnose complex failures across cloud, network, compute, storage, identity, operating systems, delivery pipelines, application hosting, observability, vendor services, and recovery layers
Can establish reliable shared services, release platforms, environments, monitoring, backup, restoration, failover, and disaster-recovery capabilities
Can make sound technical and economic trade-offs involving reliability, security, cost, delivery speed, maintainability, standardization, and team autonomy
Can lead a small technical team through coaching, prioritization, performance management, direct involvement, and clear accountability
Can communicate platform risk, DevOps constraints, operational impacts, vendor dependencies, agentic AI controls, options, and investment needs to nontechnical leaders
Can lead effectively through modernization, organizational change, constrained capacity, technical debt, and uncertainty

Good to know: 

MMG runs a predominantly Microsoft technology estate, including Majesco, Guidewire InsuranceNow, IBM i, Databricks, and Power BI, alongside emerging AI and agent-orchestration tools. You don't need hands-on experience with every platform, but you do need the judgment to apply solid platform-engineering and DevOps principles to whatever you encounter. 

Essential Functions

This position is responsible for leading MMG's platform engineering function, including cloud infrastructure, DevOps, automation, reliability, and technology operations across hybrid Azure and on-premises environments. The role requires providing strategic and day-to-day leadership to a team of engineers, collaborating with business and technology leaders, overseeing critical technology platforms and vendors, and participating in incident response, major releases, and modernization initiatives. Consistent with applicable law, reasonable accommodations will be made to support individuals with disabilities in performing the essential functions of their job provided that such accommodations do not impose an undue hardship on the business. The organization will engage in an interactive accommodation process as needed.

Compensation decisions are made in alignment with internal equity and market considerations.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Director, Information Security
for our Security Engineering and Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the security and integrity of our organization's systems, networks, and data. You will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security infrastructure and overseeing day-to-day security operations.

Leadership and Team Management:

Oversee Application Security practices working closely with Engineering teams, Dev/Ops and Platform teams.
Familiarity with detection engineering functions.

Oversee the day-to-day security operations, monitoring systems, and responding to security incidents promptly.
Lead oversight of the detection engineering / management of alerting and detections.
Implement and manage security incident response functions and procedures; including investigation, containment, and resolution of security breaches.

Manage relationships with MssP and XDR providers.

Qualifications

Strong knowledge of security principles, practices, frameworks, and industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, CIS).
Extensive experience in designing and implementing security infrastructure; including firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM, endpoint protection, etc.
Familiarity with cloud security principles and technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team.

WHY CHOOSE US?

As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.

for the Fundraising and Marketing Technology Group (FMTG), you'll lead the technical strategy behind how the American Red Cross builds relationships with the millions of donors and blood donors it depends on. You'll lead a team of four architects covering AEM, marketing communications (Adobe Campaign), fundraising systems, and analytics/personalization (Adobe Target). Your job is to show them how they get there: architect the systems, mentor your team to build working proof-of-concepts and get marketing leaders excited about what's possible.

The work location for this exciting opportunity is virtual. The selected candidate will work 100% remotely from home and can be located anywhere in the United States but must work an east coast schedule.

Anchor the Fundraising Agile Release Train as a Systems Architect, working directly with senior leadership to realize value.

Guide architectural decisions as existing martech platforms increasingly incorporate LLM-driven capabilities.

Team Leadership & Roadmapping

Manage and mentor a team of four architects (AEM, marketing communications, fundraising systems, analytics/personalization), building a culture where proof-of-concepts — not just plans — drive decisions.
Own the department's technology architecture roadmap, working directly with business leaders to translate multi-year vision into deliverable increments.
Lead evaluation and selection of architectural standards, tools, and processes across the marketing technology stack.

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

Scope: Establish operating policies and procedures that affect departments and subordinate sections and work units. Interpret company-wide policies and procedures. Develop budgets, schedules, and performance standards.

Note: Qualified candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. The American Red Cross does not sponsor employment visas.

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.*
Experience: Minimum of 10 years of experience in systems architecture or engineering.

Five or more years of architecting CRM and marketing technology solutions within Adobe Experience Cloud (AEM, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Target, Adobe Analytics) or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

Experience working in an Agile delivery environment, preferably using the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).

Director of Engineering – Digital Services

At Paymentology
, we’re building the global payments platform of the future, enabling banks, fintechs and innovators to issue and process cards across more than 60 countries.

We’re looking for an experienced Director of Engineering
to lead our Digital Services domain and play a key role in shaping the next stage of our engineering organisation.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can look beyond day-to-day delivery, think ahead, and build the technical, organisational and leadership foundations needed to scale.

Navigate ambiguity, competing priorities and cross-team dependencies, making thoughtful trade-offs between customer value, speed, quality, risk and long-term sustainability.

Who You Are

You’re a future-focused leader
who naturally thinks 6–18 months ahead, anticipating what the organisation, technology and teams will need before today’s challenges become tomorrow’s blockers.

You set a high but practical bar for excellence
, making engineering quality and continuous improvement part of everyday delivery.

You own outcomes and lead with accountability
, remaining calm and decisive through incidents, escalations and difficult trade-offs and ensuring commitments translate into action.

You’re passionate about growing other leaders

You’re a clear, collaborative communicator
