Description

Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support AWS.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Reliability & Platform Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

McMaster-Carr is trusted by industrial customers to help keep manufacturing lines running, operations moving, and customers innovating. We earn that trust by offering the right products, making them easy to find, and delivering them quickly.

Our website, mcmaster.com, is a huge part of that promise, and it's earned a reputation among engineers for being fast, reliable, and refreshingly easy to use. Customers count on it whether they're replacing a critical part, keeping operations moving, or finding exactly what they need under real time pressure.

At McMaster-Carr, engineering is central to everything we do. Our systems power a business that customers rely on every day, and the reliability, scalability, and performance of those systems directly shape the experience we deliver.

Our Culture

We intentionally cultivate a culture focused on clear execution and long-term growth. We build and maintain nearly all our critical systems ourselves, outsourcing very little, because we believe engineers who own their systems end-to-end build better ones, and many of the systems running today have been evolving here for decades. That responsibility means engineering work starts with a deep understanding of the problem and its impact, grounded in clear ownership, open communication, and direct feedback. Our teams are trusted to make thoughtful decisions about how work gets done, balancing a high bar for quality with practical execution. We've built much of our infrastructure on-premise by choice, not default, and we're bringing that same diligence with us as we extend into cloud and colocation.

Our leaders understand that great engineering organizations are not built by simply solving today’s problems. They are built by developing strong technical teams, creating systems that scale with the business, and establishing practices that allow engineers to do their best work.

How You’ll Make an Impact

We're looking for an exceptional engineering leader to help define the future of engineering at McMaster-Carr, someone who can move from solving hard technical problems themselves to leading others through those same challenges. You'll join a department where site reliability is already championed by strong technical leaders across every team you touch, but this role carries a unique charge: setting the vision for how our reliability practices evolve company-wide. Success here means cultivating strong engineering talent, providing technical leadership across multiple simultaneous efforts, and influencing outcomes well beyond your own direct contributions.
Our engineering teams operate within domains: distinct, high-impact areas of our platform that let engineers dive deep, build expertise, and release work that matters. In this role, you and your team will shape the reliability, performance, and security of the hybrid systems that power these domains, spanning on-premise data centers, cloud platforms, and the connective tissue between them. You'll partner closely with teams across:
Hybrid Infrastructure —
extend our on-premise footprint, which reflects a deliberate choice for security and uptime, not legacy inertia, while thoughtfully evolving toward cloud and colocation with that same diligence. You'll revolutionize the foundational compute, storage, and networking layers that support both worlds, ensuring seamless interoperability and predictable performance.
mcmaster.com
— own the reliability and performance of the site our customers trust most, keeping it fast, resilient, and available even under our highest-traffic, highest-pressure moments.

— strengthen the reliability of search, browsing, and systems that help customers navigate millions of SKUs.
AI & Data Systems
— scale our AI agents and the broader AI infrastructure stack to ensure low-latency inference, secure data flows, and resilient distributed systems.
Fulfillment & Automation
— build and harden the systems that integrate with warehouse automation, delivery orchestration, and customer service operations.

What You’ll Do

Your first 30 days
are about learning with purpose: understanding our current architecture, identifying opportunities to improve the performance of data flow across our systems, and building fluency in our operational tooling. You’ll begin by improving targeted components—small enough to ramp quickly, substantial enough to matter.

Partnering with engineering leaders to define long‑term architectural direction
, ensuring our platforms scale securely and while remaining performant.

, including secure ingress/egress, zero‑trust networking, and multi‑region failover.

, from identity boundaries to network segmentation to runtime security.
Driving incident response maturity
, reducing time‑to‑detect and time‑to‑restore through automation, runbooks, and systemic improvements.
Upskilling your team
through mentorship, technical coaching, and creating an environment where engineers can do their best work.

You’ll create clarity where requirements are fuzzy, build momentum across teams, and deliver durable solutions that raise the reliability bar for the entire organization.

What You Bring

8+ years of experience
in Site Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with deep ownership of production systems and direct experience managing and developing engineers.
A track record of growing engineers through complex, large-scale systems work, knowing when to dive into the architecture yourself and when to maximize your leverage by coaching someone else through it.

, including on‑premise data centers, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and a strong command of networking fundamentals

new_jobs.description:
Description

We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels heard and respected, and extending our culture of care so that every individual can reach their full potential. We want you to have a sense of belonging and feel valued for your contributions and the perspectives you bring.

Summary

The VP, Transmission & Distribution (T&D) is the P&L owner for the T&D business unit, with full accountability for revenue, margin, and cost. This role drives profitable growth of the business unit through disciplined operational execution and proactive business development. This role oversees all day-to-day project activities and the long-term strategic direction of the T&D business unit, including Transmission, Substation/Switchyard, and general high and medium voltage construction projects across the U.S. The VP is fully accountable for the business unit’s financial performance — revenue, margin, and cost — and serves as the primary client-facing leader for the T&D business.

The T&D business unit is responsible for standalone transmission and distribution projects that are independent of our core EPC projects. The work is primarily construction-focused, although there may be opportunities for the T&D business unit to support engineering and procurement activities as needed.

Working hand-in-hand with Business Development resources, this leader is responsible for identifying, pursuing, securing, negotiating, and executing construction contracts. The VP will build and maintain strong client relationships, grow the T&D construction pipeline, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards. Direct reports include Pre-Construction, Estimating, and Project Directors, who are accountable for the execution of T&D projects. The VP works collaboratively with Operations and support functions across the broader organization to ensure projects are appropriately staffed, including disciplined workforce planning and resource forecasting. This position reports to the SVP, U.S. EPC and T&D.

Preferred location is Denver, CO or Houston, TX. The role requires regular presence at RES corporate headquarters in Denver alongside frequent client and project site travel. Candidates outside these markets will be considered based on their ability to meet the travel requirements of the position.

Requirements

Owns full P&L accountability for the T&D business unit, including revenue, margin, cost management, and monthly financial forecasting; directly leads Pre-Construction, Estimating, and Project Directors responsible for project execution, and reports business unit financial performance to SVP, U.S. EPC and T&D.
Develops, reviews, and re-defines the business strategy for profitable growth of the business unit; responsible for a three-year business plan including HSQE, revenue, and profit targets.
Ensures projects are completed safely and according to the planned schedule and budget.
Ensures that environmental stewardship meets or exceeds contractual requirements and regional regulations.
Ensures that company management systems, including HSQE, stage gate, and project management processes, are followed and implemented.
Partners with Business Development resources to identify, pursue, and win new T&D project opportunities; leads or supports contract negotiations with owners and subcontractors.
Performs budget management, estimate reviews, budget preparation, and monthly status reviews.
Leads monthly project reviews for all business unit projects and reports on key project performance to Executive Leadership Team.
Leads Project Management and Senior T&D Management meetings for internal project status.
Identifies risks and opportunities to the monthly financial forecast and resolves all issues to mitigate risks and capture opportunities to improve business unit performance.
Leads workforce planning and resource forecasting for the T&D Construction business unit; works collaboratively with Operations and support functions across the organization to ensure projects are appropriately staffed; performs talent management, staffing reviews, and succession planning focused on leadership-level roles.
Travels for negotiations, project site visits, and internal and client meetings.
Serves as the primary client-facing executive for the T&D business; builds and maintains senior client relationships, proactively addresses concerns, resolves project issues, and finalizes change orders while protecting and growing the client relationship.
Attends work regularly and punctually, as scheduled or expected.
Complies with Employee Handbook, Code of Conduct, and Company Policies & Procedures.
Collaborates with external engineers, clients, and Pre-Construction to drive constructability into the project development process, ensuring designs are practical, safe, and optimized for efficient field execution.

Additional Responsibilities

Leads the T&D construction pursuit process; reviews and approves proposals, coordinates with Business Development on go/no-go decisions, and represents RES in client-facing proposal presentations. Maintains accountability for the T&D new contract award pipeline and reports regularly on business development progress and market opportunities to SVP, U.S. EPC and T&D
In collaboration with Commercial and Legal groups, prepare risk management and approval papers per the Stage-Gate and LOA requirements.
Assists in the development of standard substation designs in collaboration with Engineering to provide efficient, repeatable solutions for clients.
Drives innovation in construction methods and technology to improve safety, productivity, and project delivery outcomes.
Collaborates with HSQE, Commercial, PMO, Operational Excellence, and Engineering groups as required for process implementation and improvement.
Collaborates with the EPC business unit and support functions to ensure project execution consistency, as well as supporting EPC Pre-Construction on planning and estimating as required to support HV scopes for their projects.
For select projects, the T&D business unit may engage with engineering activities in support of client needs. This role ensures appropriate collaboration through Pre-Construction and other organizational functions to deploy the right engineering resources and expertise.

Safety

Presents, supports, and leads-by-example with a safety and quality-oriented attitude.
Leads by example to show that safety is the most important function, ensuring that all employees follow safe practices while working.
Accountable to continually reinforce safe behaviors and correct “at risk” behaviors.
Adheres to and ensures all site team members understands standard operating procedures.
Leads and supports the site team in technical, quality and safety, utilizing system in place.

Leadership

Fosters and demonstrates a workplace inclusive of creating opportunity, serving others, building trust, innovation, and exceeding expectations.
Leads a direct report team including Pre-Construction, Estimating, and Project Directors, with overall accountability for a broad T&D construction operations organization spanning multiple concurrent projects.
Participates in hiring and selection process to fill positions on the team.
Communicates regularly with direct reports on goals, accomplishments, and information on policies.
Demonstrates leadership and expertise in eyes of client group.
Employee Development:
Provides tasks and assignments that challenge and stretch employees’ responsibilities.
Conducts regular discussions with employee(s) on personal development. Comfortable with empowering others.
Conducts timely, effective performance reviews in accordance with RES guidelines.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or construction is required.
Master’s degree in business is preferred.
10+ years of industry-related experience in operationally complex organizations is required.
10+ years of leadership experience managing construction projects and teams, including both direct team leadership development and large operations team leadership is required.
5+ years of experience in a client-facing or business development capacity within T&D or energy infrastructure construction, including relationship management, pursuit strategy, and contract negotiation is preferred.
Ability to travel 51-75% domestically required.
A valid driver’s license is required.
A track record of strong financial and general management business ownership at high-performing organizations.
Proven experience creating and executing strategies that brought together disparate teams with different cultures to create a larger, sustainable organization.
Strong analytical skills with the demonstrated ability to use data analysis to build actionable insights.
Ability to understand new areas within the business and desire to operate outside the current comfort zone.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to tailor them to individual personalities.
Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and the desire to bring structure to undefined procedures.
Internal communication with executive managers, Directors, Project Managers, Estimators, Project Developers, Site Accountants, Engineering, Legal, HSQE, and H.R. and cross-functional departmental teams.
Demonstrated business development acumen, including experience cultivating client relationships, developing pursuit strategies, and closing construction contracts in the T&D or broader energy infrastructure market.
Develops motivation techniques to lead a team that suits our company values and employee commitment.
Functional competencies include accountability, building strategic partnerships, business acumen, ethics & integrity, and managing vision & purpose.
Previous experience with direct interface with Engineering teams is critical.

RES offers benefits that are effective first day of employment. These benefits include the following:

Medical, Dental and Vision
Health Savings Account with employer contribution
Flexible Spending Accounts
4x pay Basic Life and Voluntary Life
Short and Long Term Disability
Accident, Hospital, and Critical Illness
401 (k) plan with 6% company match
4 weeks Paid Time Off (PTO) and 10 Paid Holidays
Tuition Reimbursement and Green Car Reimbursement
Volunteer and Charity Matching
Paid Parental Leave and Paid Sabbatical Leave
Employee Referral Bonus
Employee Discounts and Wellness programs
Wellness Reimbursement

Physical Requirements And Environment

The work environment and physical demands characteristics are representative of those the employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Rarely: Crouching, kneeling, lifting 5-15 lbs. and stooping is required.

Occasionally: Climbing, pinching, pulling/pushing between 5-15lbs. is required.

Frequently: Carrying 5-15lbs., gripping, handling, standing and walking is required.

Constantly: Reading, grasping, hearing, reaching, vision, repetitive motion, and sitting is required.

Frequently exposed to extreme cold, heat, and humidity, wet climates, noise, hazards, and vibration in the working environment.

We maintain a drug-free workplace. Candidates will be required to pass a pre-employment background investigation and drug test as a condition of employment.

new_jobs.title: Director Network Operations Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
Pension / Retirement benefits
Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have in This Role

As Director, Network Operations Engineering, you will lead the strategy, architecture, and operational excellence of enterprise network services that support critical business operations and client connectivity. You will be accountable for building resilient, secure, scalable, and cloud‑ready network platforms across campus, data center, colocation, hybrid, and cloud environments.

In this role, you will drive a cloud‑first, automation‑led network strategy, improve operational reliability and recovery, and strengthen governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) maturity. You will lead and grow a high‑performing team of network engineers while partnering closely with product, infrastructure, security, audit, and risk teams to ensure network services meet business, client, and regulatory expectations.

This role reports directly to Network Operations leadership.

Your Primary Responsibilities

Network Architecture & Strategy

Define and lead the design and implementation of complex enterprise network architectures, including LAN, WAN, data center, SD‑WAN, and hybrid cloud environments
Develop and execute network strategies and multi‑year roadmaps aligned with business objectives and industry best practices
Establish enterprise standards for network design, client connectivity, resiliency, and security
Evaluate emerging networking technologies and recommend solutions that improve performance, scalability, reliability, and security

Network Operations, Reliability & Performance

Own enterprise‑level network operations, ensuring availability, capacity, performance, and security across on‑prem and cloud environments
Oversee the operation of routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, wireless infrastructure, and cloud networking services
Lead the response to complex network incidents, including root‑cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions
Reduce operational risk by improving testing practices, recovery planning, and standardization of connectivity models
Monitor network performance, utilization, and capacity; sponsor optimization initiatives such as traffic engineering and QoS

Cloud, Automation & Modernization

Lead execution of the cloud and hybrid network strategy, including hybrid connectivity, cloud networking patterns, and cost‑optimization initiatives
Drive adoption of network automation and Infrastructure as Code, leveraging tools such as Ansible, Python, and SDN technologies
Ensure network provisioning, configuration management, and change execution are automated to improve efficiency and reduce manual errors
Establish cloud‑specific operational models, including monitoring, incident management, and financial governance

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Own network‑related governance, risk, and compliance responsibilities
Standardize network documentation, controls, and audit evidence
Track audit findings, remediation actions, and control effectiveness through structured governance forums
Partner with security, risk, and audit teams to ensure ongoing regulatory readiness

Leadership, Delivery & Vendor Management

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of network operations and engineering professionals, with planned growth as demand increases
Set priorities, performance goals, and accountability across the organization
Lead network‑related programs and initiatives, including upgrades, migrations, and technology refreshes
Define project scope, timelines, resources, and budgets to ensure delivery on schedule and within constraints
Evaluate network vendors, support contract negotiations, and manage strategic vendor relationships
Ensure high‑quality network documentation, diagrams, procedures, and knowledge sharing
Communicate network risks, initiatives, and incidents effectively to senior leadership, including executive‑ready presentations (PowerPoint, Visio)

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in network engineering, operations, or infrastructure leadership roles within large, global enterprises
Demonstrated experience leading and developing technical teams
Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent practical experience
Experience supporting regulated or highly audited environments

Talents Needed for Success

Deep expertise in enterprise network architecture and operations
Expert‑level knowledge of networking protocols and technologies, including: - TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS
VLAN, STP
Network security protocols (IPsec, SSL/TLS)
Strong experience with data center, hybrid, and cloud networking
Extensive experience with enterprise network devices and vendors
In‑depth understanding of network security principles, including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and access control
Proven ability to lead incident response, root‑cause analysis, and operational improvement programs
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills
Demonstrated experience driving organizational process improvement and change

Nice to Have Skills

Experience with Infoblox, Guardicore, or similar network/IPAM/security platforms
Prior ownership of client connectivity platforms or services
Experience building centralized network topology or observability repositories
Advanced network certifications (CCIE, JNCIE)

new_jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Manager - AI Memory Systems, Customer 360
new_jobs.description:
Description

Every time a customer tells Alexa about a dietary preference, buys running shoes, streams a sci-fi movie, or adds dog food to their cart, that moment should shape every future interaction across Amazon. Your job is to make that happen.

We're hiring a Senior Manager to lead the teams that build Amazon's AI memory — the system that understands who each customer is, what they care about, who's in their family (pets included), and what they need next. Your work powers every major AI experience at Amazon: Alexa+, Alexa for Shopping, Search, Homepage, Prime Video, Music, Audible, Health AI, and more. This is a critical company-wide initiative touching every business at Amazon.

What Makes This Role Different

You own the full pipeline from raw signal to real-time AI retrieval — not just one piece of the stack
Your science teams generate inferences across all of Amazon's businesses, not a single vertical
You partner with 10+ organizations and influence without authority at the most senior levels
You build for conversational AI agents that need to recall the right memory in the right moment at real-time speed

The systems you own are already at massive scale and growing fast — this isn't a roadmap on a whiteboard

If you want to shape how AI understands and remembers hundreds of millions of customers, and you thrive leading science and engineering teams through ambiguity at scale, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities

Lead and grow multiple science and engineering teams that generate, store, and serve customer inferences across all Amazon businesses — building the AI-ready representations that power personalized experiences for hundreds of millions of customers.

Own the customer inference pipeline end-to-end: from raw signals (purchases, browsing, streaming, listening, reading, conversations) through inference generation to real-time retrieval by AI agents and recommendation systems.

Drive memory quality at scale: establish precision and recall targets, build evaluation frameworks, and continuously improve the accuracy of both explicit memories (what customers tell us) and inferred memories (what we learn from their behavior).

Serve as the primary technical voice for customer understanding in executive reviews, translating complex inference systems into clear narratives about customer impact and business value.

Partner with 10+ organizations (Alexa, Alexa for Shopping, Search, Prime Video, Music, Audible, Books, Ads, Grocery, Health AI, Amazon Business) to ensure customer memories are adopted and delivering value across every major Amazon surface.

Establish cross-business data governance standards — authoring schemas, onboarding processes, and quality gates that allow dozens of businesses to contribute customer signals into a unified system without compromising data integrity.

Hire, develop, and retain world-class applied scientists and engineers, fostering a culture of scientific rigor, rapid experimentation, and customer obsession.

Customer 360 is Amazon's central memory system. Our mission: when a customer interacts with any part of Amazon, every other part reflects that understanding immediately. Our memories fuel Amazon's largest AI initiatives including Alexa+, Alexa for Shopping, Health AI, conversational assistants, generative recommendation systems, and personalized discovery across every major surface. We operate at massive scale. We are a team of builders who believe that understanding customers deeply — and remembering what matters to them — is the foundation of every great AI experience.

new_jobs.title: Vice President, Engineering and Technology
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Introduction – Why This Role Matters for Insitu

Insitu is redefining the future of unmanned aviation, delivering autonomous vehicle systems and mission solutions that support critical intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) missions for global defense and security customers. As our Vice President, Engineering and Technology, you will be the senior technical leader guiding the next generation of Insitu’s platforms, payloads, autonomy, and mission services—shaping how our customers sense, decide, and act in the most demanding environments.

This is a high‑impact, enterprise‑wide role that combines technology strategy, engineering leadership, and operational integration. You will report directly to the CEO, lead both Engineering and Flight Operations through your department directors, and set the technical direction that underpins Insitu’s growth, competitiveness, and long‑term innovation roadmap.

Job Description Summary

The Vice President of Engineering and Technology is the company’s senior technical leader and primary technology strategist. This role owns the long‑term technology vision and roadmap for our autonomous systems portfolio and ensures that major business and investment decisions are grounded in deep technical insight and aligned with company strategy and customer mission needs.

The VP, Engineering and Technology sets and communicates the technology direction, architects the product and platform strategy, prioritizes R&D and capital investments, and maintains a coherent “system‑of‑systems” vision across platforms, payloads, autonomy, ground systems, and data/software.

This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer and is a key member of the executive leadership team, acting as the company’s chief technical authority and external technology ambassador.

The Engineering and Flight Operations departments both report directly to this position. The VP, Engineering and Technology provides executive leadership and guidance to both organizations and is accountable for integrating Engineering and Flight Operations to deliver safe, reliable, and innovative autonomous vehicle systems and mission services that meet customer, quality, regulatory, and contractual requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Vision, Strategy & Architecture
Own and continuously evolve the company’s multi‑year technology vision and roadmap for unmanned and autonomous systems, aligned with long‑range business plans, customer mission outcomes, and innovation priorities.
Lead portfolio‑level technology and architecture decisions (e.g., make/buy/partner, modularity vs. integration, open architectures) to optimize capability, schedule, lifecycle cost, and technical risk.
Translate emerging tech trends (autonomy/AI, advanced sensors, secure networking, cloud‑enabled mission services, digital engineering) into concrete, prioritized roadmaps and investment themes.
Chair key technical governance forums (e.g., Architecture Review Board, Design Authority reviews) to maintain technical integrity, reuse, and common standards across programs.
Innovation, R&D & Productization
Drive a focused, high‑impact R&D portfolio aligned with the technology strategy and customer needs, making clear go/hold/stop decisions on major technology bets.
Guide the maturation of technologies from concept and prototype through flight test, production, and in‑service evolution.
Sponsor and review research and case studies on leading‑edge technologies, identifying differentiating capabilities and ensuring rapid learning cycles (demo, test, iterate).
Chief Technical Authority & Governance
Serve as the company’s ultimate technical authority for key design and architecture decisions, technical risk acceptance, and technology trade‑offs.
Establish and track key technical KPIs/OKRs (e.g., defect rates, design cycle times, test coverage, reliability metrics) and drive continuous improvement based on data.
Engineering & Flight Organization Leadership
Lead and integrate a multi‑disciplinary Engineering organization (Systems, Software, AI/Autonomy, Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Payloads, Test) to deliver cohesive, high‑impact solutions for global defense and security customers.
Scale and structure the Engineering and Flight Operations organizations to meet strategic growth; assign authority and responsibility to department directors and their leadership teams, and monitor execution.
Build and maintain a strong technical ladder, including Principal/Chief Engineers, to provide deep expertise, mentorship, and design leadership across programs.
Provide strategic oversight and technical direction through the Director, Flight Operations to ensure operations (flight test, training, deployed missions) are tightly integrated with the technology roadmap and product strategy
Customer, Market & Ecosystem Engagement
Engage directly with key customers, end‑users, and partners to understand mission problems, shape the technology roadmap around real operational needs, and advocate for investment priorities.
Represent the company’s technology strategy and capabilities at customer briefings, industry events, standards bodies, and with key suppliers, serving as an external technical thought leader.
Provide authoritative technical input to major pursuits and strategic partnerships, including solution architectures, discriminators, and risk/feasibility assessments.
Executive Leadership, Culture & Governance
Partner with Programs, Operations, Product Lines, Business Development, and Finance to ensure technology strategy and engineering execution support growth, profitability, and long‑range business plans.
Lead, mentor, and inspire Engineering and Flight Operations leadership and their teams, reinforcing a culture of technical excellence, safety, integrity, and accountability.
Build and sustain an inclusive, high‑performance culture that attracts, develops, and retains top technical and operational talent.
Own Engineering and Flight Operations budgets and resource plans, ensuring investments and staffing align with strategic priorities and program commitments.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a closely related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

Experience

Extensive experience in aerospace, defense, and/or autonomous systems, with significant time in senior technical leadership roles (e.g., Vice President, Chief Engineer, Head of Engineering, or equivalent).
Demonstrated experience defining and executing technology strategy and technical roadmaps for complex, software‑enabled hardware products.
Proven track record partnering with Programs/Operations and Business Development to deliver on schedule, on budget, and to spec for government or highly regulated customers.
Demonstrated success managing sizable departmental budgets and contributing to annual operating plans and long‑range business planning.
Ability to engage credibly at a deep technical level (e.g., architecture trade‑offs, algorithm performance, system safety, test strategies) while maintaining a portfolio‑level strategic view.

Leadership & Interpersonal Skills

Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high‑performing technical organizations in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments.
Strong cross‑functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders from engineering, operations, programs, finance, and business development.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics in clear business and operational terms to executives, customers, and partners.
Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, make sound decisions with incomplete data, and drive clarity, focus, and accountability.

Desired Qualifications

Ability to obtain or maintain a Secret Security Clearance
Prior experience as a senior technology leader (e.g., VP‑level Engineering/Technology, Chief Engineer) in aerospace, defense, or autonomous systems organizations.
Deep familiarity with small tactical UAS, ISR mission concepts, and associated ground and data systems.
Hands‑on or leadership experience in autonomy/AI for UAS, advanced payloads, mission systems, or secure communications networks.
Demonstrated experience with Profit & Loss responsibility or strong P&L fluency in a technology‑ and operations‑intensive business.
Familiarity with export control environments (e.g., ITAR/EAR) and experience working with U.S. and/or allied defense and security customers.

This role is eligible for hybrid work. There is a strong preference that this individual is on site at our facilities in Bingen, WA 3+ days/week. The ability to travel is required - travel needs will vary based on customer/partnership opportunities, timing of events, etc.

new_jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering & AI
new_jobs.description:
Vice President of Engineering & AI

SourceNow | Remote – United States | Full-Time

The Opportunity

SourceNow is seeking an exceptional Vice President of Engineering & AI to lead the continued evolution of our engineering, AI, technology, and IT capabilities and help build the next generation of our enterprise workforce technology platform, SN1.

This is not a traditional technology executive role. We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader who still builds.

The successful candidate must be equally comfortable setting engineering and AI strategy with executive leadership and opening the codebase to personally write production-quality code, review pull requests, design APIs, troubleshoot performance issues, architect systems, and build new AI-powered capabilities. If you have moved completely away from coding and hands-on engineering, this is not the right opportunity.

We are looking for a builder, engineer, architect, AI practitioner, product thinker, and technology leader who can move seamlessly between executive strategy and hands-on engineering execution.

Our objective is to continue evolving SN1 into an AI-first enterprise workforce technology platform where AI, automation, data, engineering, and conversational experiences fundamentally improve how organizations manage their workforce.

This Is a Hands-On Engineering Role

Technical credibility is essential.

The VP of Engineering & AI must remain a current software engineer and personally participate in engineering and product development.

You should be comfortable:

Writing production-quality code
Personally contributing to software engineering
Designing and building full-stack applications
Building frontend and backend systems
Designing and consuming REST APIs
Reviewing code and engineering pull requests
Troubleshooting complex production issues
Designing scalable application architecture
Building scalable data models
Improving application performance
Working with cloud infrastructure
Rapidly prototyping product concepts
Building and deploying AI applications
Taking features from concept through production
Establishing engineering and coding standards
Working directly alongside engineers when needed

We want an executive who can lead engineers because they understand engineering firsthand—not because they used to engineer years ago.

AI Engineering & AI Product Development

AI will be a core component of SourceNow's product and technology strategy.

This leader will help establish and execute our AI strategy, AI engineering architecture, AI development practices, and AI product roadmap.

We are specifically looking for candidates with hands-on experience building and deploying production AI applications, not simply managing AI initiatives.

Experience may include:

Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)
AI application development
AI agents and agentic workflows
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Tool calling and function calling
Prompt and context engineering
Structured model outputs
AI evaluation and testing
Embeddings
Vector databases
Semantic search
AI workflow orchestration
Model selection and routing
AI data pipelines
AI observability and monitoring
AI security, permissions, and guardrails
Responsible AI
AI reliability
Cost and latency optimization
Enterprise AI integrations

We want someone who understands the difference between creating an impressive AI demonstration and engineering reliable AI products that enterprise customers can safely use in production.

Full-Stack Engineering

This role requires deep experience across modern full-stack software engineering.

You should be comfortable working across:

Frontend Engineering:

JavaScript, TypeScript, modern frameworks, component-based applications, responsive interfaces, and scalable frontend architecture.

Backend Engineering:

APIs, services, authentication, authorization, business logic, distributed systems, application performance, and scalable backend architecture.

Data Engineering:

Relational databases, data modeling, query optimization, analytics, data pipelines, reporting infrastructure, and AI-oriented data architecture.

Cloud Engineering & DevOps:

Cloud-native architecture, CI/CD, deployment, scalability, monitoring, observability, reliability, security, infrastructure, and disaster recovery.

Integration Engineering:

REST APIs, webhooks, SFTP, middleware, file integrations, authentication, data synchronization, and enterprise system integrations.

Experience integrating with HRIS, HCM, ERP, payroll, timekeeping, financial, staffing, VMS, workforce management, or other enterprise technology systems is especially valuable.

Engineering, Technology & IT Leadership

The VP of Engineering & AI will lead across four interconnected areas:

Engineering. AI. Product Technology. IT.

Key areas of responsibility include:

Software engineering
Full-stack engineering
AI engineering
AI product development
Enterprise IT
Cloud infrastructure
Application and data architecture
Cybersecurity
APIs and enterprise integrations
DevOps and deployment
Engineering operations
Product technology strategy
Technical hiring
Engineering leadership
IT security and governance
SOC 2 technology controls
Business continuity and disaster recovery

This individual will help ensure SourceNow's engineering systems, AI capabilities, IT infrastructure, cloud environments, development environments, architecture, security controls, and enterprise technology are scalable, secure, and reliable.

Product & AI Innovation

Technology at SourceNow exists to solve customer problems.

You will partner with executive leadership, Product, Engineering, customers, and business teams to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions.

You will help:

Define the technical roadmap for SN1
Establish our AI and engineering roadmap
Translate business strategy into technology architecture
Rapidly prototype new ideas
Evaluate emerging AI technologies
Improve engineering velocity
Improve platform scalability and reliability
Manage technical debt intelligently
Make build-versus-buy decisions
Strengthen enterprise integrations
Improve development processes
Build infrastructure capable of supporting continued growth

Potential AI initiatives include:

Conversational workforce management
AI reporting and analytics
Intelligent job creation
AI talent matching
Supplier intelligence
AI-powered workflow automation
Predictive workforce intelligence
AI agents
AI-powered customer experiences

We also expect you to bring AI and engineering ideas we have not yet considered.

Engineering Leadership

This is an executive leadership role and a hands-on engineering position.

You will:

Lead and mentor software engineers
Recruit exceptional engineering and AI talent
Establish engineering standards
Improve code-review practices
Lead architecture decisions
Create accountability around delivery
Improve engineering velocity and quality
Develop engineering talent
Strengthen technical documentation
Build a culture of experimentation and execution
Remain personally involved in critical engineering and AI initiatives

We want someone who raises the technical capability of everyone around them while remaining close enough to the technology to personally build when necessary.

What We're Looking For

Strong candidates will likely bring:

10+ years of software engineering experience
Significant full-stack engineering experience
Current hands-on coding ability
Meaningful hands-on AI/LLM engineering experience
Experience building and deploying production AI applications
Experience leading software engineering teams
Experience with enterprise SaaS applications
Strong cloud architecture experience
Strong API and enterprise integration experience
Experience with scalable data architecture
Knowledge of modern IT environments
Experience with application and cloud security
Experience shipping enterprise production software
Experience recruiting and mentoring technical talent
Experience as a VP of Engineering, VP of Technology, Engineering Director, CTO, Head of Engineering, or similar technology leader is valuable.
Experience within HR technology, workforce management, staffing technology, VMS, HCM, ERP, payroll, or enterprise SaaS is a plus but not required.

We are interested in hiring an exceptional engineering and AI leader who can learn workforce technology than a technology leader who already knows the industry.

The Person We're Looking For:

A Builder. You still love writing code and creating software.
An AI Practitioner. You have personally built AI applications.
An Architect. You understand how today's engineering decisions affect tomorrow's platform.
A Product Thinker. You connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.
A Leader. You can recruit, mentor, challenge, and inspire strong engineers.
Entrepreneurial. You thrive in an environment where ideas can move quickly from discussion to prototype to production.
Pragmatic. You know when to build, when to buy, when to iterate, and when not to over-engineer.
The Builder Test

Before applying, ask yourself:

What have I personally built recently?

What AI systems have I personally built?

How frequently do I write code today?

Would I be excited to spend several hours tomorrow debugging and writing production code?

If the answer to that last question is yes, we want to talk to you.

Why SourceNow

Workforce technology is entering a period of fundamental change. AI creates an opportunity to move enterprise software beyond traditional menus, forms, dashboards, and workflows.

Software can understand intent.
Data can become conversational.
AI agents can automate workflows.
Technology can actively help users make better decisions.

SourceNow intends to be at the forefront of that transition.

We are looking for a technology leader who wants to help us build it.

Not observe it. Not advise from the sidelines. Build it.

This role will guide product architecture, stage-gate development, technical support, manufacturing improvement, and root-cause investigations across hardware, firmware, software integration, and device engineering, with a strong focus on cohesive product systems and customer solutions that span hardware and software.

The ideal candidate has deep hardware engineering experience, proven product-development leadership, and the ability to take complex hardware products from concept through release, as well as the systems perspective to align embedded, application, and SDK-level software with the hardware roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the hardware product development team and direct the associated software engineering execution, coordinating with complementary teams in Asia.
Translate customer and market requirements into integrated product solutions, ensuring hardware, firmware, and application software deliver a consistent customer experience.
Manage stage-gate product development, including checklists, reviews, and stakeholder alignment.
Drive product architecture, redesign, prototyping, benchmarking, and performance improvements.
Own design for manufacturing and design for test (DFM/DFT) implementation during product development, releasing designs that are manufacturable and testable, and supporting the quality, manufacturing, and cost-reduction owners downstream.
Lead root-cause analysis and technical investigations involving fingerprint sensor technology.
Identify, test, and qualify new electronic and hardware components.
Manage technical support for existing hardware products and contribute to new technology proposals.
Build and sustain a close working partnership with our engineering and manufacturing organization in South Korea.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
10–15 years of hands-on engineering experience, including prior team leadership.
Experience managing multidisciplinary teams (software, firmware, hardware), with demonstrated ability to align hardware and software delivery schedules.
Strong hardware background, including SoCs, ARM processors, PCBs, FPGAs, CPLDs, and embedded systems.
Demonstrated DFM/DFT discipline in volume production, (e.g. tooling, test fixture development, pilot builds, and hand-off).
Experience with communication protocols such as USB, Parallel, MIPI, and SPI.
Proficiency with Linux, Windows, Android, and iOS environments.
Experience with PCB design tools such as OrCAD, PADS, or Eagle.
Expert-level C/C++ skills and some Verilog HDL knowledge.

:

This role demands not only technical expertise in modern front-end technologies—such as React, Next.js, Flexbox, TailwindCSS, CSS animations, JavaScript animations, HTML email creation, and banner ad creation—but also a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical promotions industry. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in translating client needs into innovative, high-quality digital products while maintaining direct communication with clients to ensure their expectations are not only met but exceeded.

Key Responsibilities
:
Innovative Technology Solutions
:
Lead the development of innovative front-end solutions that set industry standards and deliver exceptional user experiences.
Utilize cutting-edge technologies, including React, Next.js, Flexbox, TailwindCSS, CSS animations, and JavaScript animations, to create highly responsive and visually engaging digital products.
Oversee the creation of HTML emails and banner ads that are not only compliant with industry standards but also stand out in terms of design and functionality.
Foster a culture of innovation within the team, encouraging the exploration of new technologies and approaches to solve complex challenges.

Client-Focused Development
:
Engage directly with clients to understand their unique needs, challenges, and objectives.
Translate client requirements into detailed technical specifications and project plans.

:

Collaborate with other directors and executives to align technology initiatives with business goals and client requirements.

Pharmaceutical Promotions Expertise
:

Project Management

new_jobs.description:
Role Overview

Phillips Heavy is seeking a Director of Mission Critical Infrastructure to lead strategy, pursuits, bidding, planning and management of site development execution for mission critical data centers, domestic manufacturing facilities, e-infrastructure and power generation. This is a senior-level role requiring deep technical expertise in site development for civil infrastructure, utility coordination, permitting, procurement, P&L oversight, and large-scale construction oversight. The ideal candidate will bring leadership experience, industry insight, and a proven track record managing large scale infrastructure construction in active or greenfield environments.

Key Responsibilities

Lead strategy, assemble market intelligence and develop a high performing team to expand Phillips’s capabilities to deliver large turnkey site development solutions for mission critical data centers, domestic manufacturing, e-infrastructure and power generation.
Support multiple field leadership teams in the execution of site development activities including excavation, grading, foundations, stormwater systems, underground utility installation (power, water, sewer, fiber), and roadways.
Collaborate with developers, civil engineers, general contractors, subcontractors, and utility providers to ensure accurate design execution and timely project delivery.
Oversee site-specific budgets, schedules, procurement, and risk mitigation from pre-construction through handover.
Provide on-site leadership and enforce Phillips’s integrity, safety, quality, and production protocols, particularly in environments with live systems or phased commissioning.
Establish and uphold documentation standards by monitoring accuracy and completeness of progress reports, change logs, compliance records, and turnover materials.
Partner with development, pre-construction and operations teams to evaluate early-phase feasibility studies, site assessments, and due diligence for new opportunities.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related field (Master’s preferred).
10+ years of experience in infrastructure or civil construction with at least 5 years in mission critical environments (data centers, manufacturing facilities, e-infrastructure, power generation, etc.).
Proven ability to manage large-scale, fast-track projects with complex site logistics and multiple stakeholders.
Deep knowledge of utility coordination, entitlements, permitting, and civil site design integration.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and conflict resolution skills.
Strong background in project controls, cost management, and construction scheduling (Primavera P6, MS Project, or similar).
Experience managing teams on-site, including subcontractors, inspectors, and third-party consultants.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working on hyperscale or large colocation data center campuses.
PMP, CCM, or other professional project management certifications.
OSHA 30, NFPA 70E, or other advanced safety training.
Familiarity with enterprise commissioning practices and integrating site work into mechanical/electrical commissioning phases.
